t: The 4lite Tornado twin 6ft LED non-corrosive batten fitting is a robust and efficient lighting solution. This 70W, 7700 lumen LED batten provides bright 4000K cool white illumination, making it ideal for workshops, garages, and outdoor areas. Its durable polycarbonate body and diffuser ensure an IP65 rating for dust and water protection, suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. Designed for easy installation, it offers point-to-point replacement for existing fluorescent luminaires and includes luminaire fixing clips for BESA box mounting. Lockable heavy-duty stainless steel clips are supplied for enhanced safety and security.
b: Flexible Installation with Multiple Cable Entries
Lockable Stainless Steel Clips Ensure Secure Mounting
